dedupe_keys.name: hydro morphodynamic data from numerical simulations of different dam scenarios in andean rivers of the amazon basin

description: Hydro-morphodynamic data from numerical simulations of different dam scenarios in Andean Rivers of the Amazon Basin is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environmental Information Data Centre. The data contains the model output files from eRiDynaS. eRiDynaS is a two-dimensional (grid-based, depth-averaged) River Dynamics Simulator that incorporates equations representing water flow, multi-fraction sediment transport, bank erosion and floodplain processes. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Environmental Information Data Centre. Its tags are Amazonian foreland rivers, Bolivia, Meandering sand bed rivers, Peru, dam construction. It offers 2 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-07-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
